kaikki_vikisozluk.e: مَنْ تَأَنَّى نَالَ مَا تَمَنَّى • (man taʔannā nāla mā tamannā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Literally, “He who acts with deliberation attains what he wished for.”.
s: “He who acts with deliberation attains what he wished for.”
Literally, “He who acts with deliberation attains what he wished for.”
g: slow and steady wins the race, haste makes waste, patience is a virtue
